svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Features menu (Bin Wall)
svg.desc: Bin-label launcher: every feature is a label plate with a code, hung on a louvre wall in flow order; stage-2 features are empty slots.
svg.text: Go to: type a code or a name
e.g. MOV opens the move list, B/A the before/after table
Data as of 2026-06-30 · no moves yet
Three files or an existing import
Work left to right, top row first
Picks in the period, by class
Next: apply or keep in place, run again for round 2, then check Before/after and print the Move list.
